Galette 1.3.0 is out! 🎉

🔐 Two-factor authentication (experimental) and throttling of failed logins
📨 Mailings sent in batches, with hourly and daily quotas (experimental)
⚙️ A new advanced configuration page
🧩 Reworked plugins management
♿ A big accessibility effort

All plugins have been updated as well. PHP 8.3 minimum.

https://galette.eu/site/post/2026/10/03/galette-1-3-0/

#Galette #FreeSoftware #OpenSource #NonProfit
